mujoco_depth.evidence: Scene uses MJCF free bodies, slide and hinge joints, position actuators, collision geoms, touch sensors, wrist IMU, frame-position sensors, cameras, lights, and dynamic objects.

control.evidence: Behavior-cloned tactile phase policy with minimum-jerk transport, contact-gated stabilization, class-conditioned placement, and release verification.

dexterous_manipulation.evidence: Five active tactile fingers, 216-degree cap rotation, 0.36 mm slip recovery, and 9x load hold are logged.

engineering_quality.evidence: Deterministic seed, structured Python runner, validator, CSV telemetry, JSON policy, layout report, manifest, and documented review path.

presentation.evidence: Generated 60 second H.264 video with compact captions; the amber capsule dexterity sequence appears first.

innovation.evidence: Compact disaster/medication triage workcell doubles as a synchronized data-collection environment for labels, poses, tactile state, confidence, and task metrics.
